teams_name_override_check.name: teams_name_override_check
teams_name_override_check.value: "teams"."name_override" IS NULL OR char_length("teams"."name_override") BETWEEN 1 AND 60

career_event_instances_resolution_check.name: career_event_instances_resolution_check
career_event_instances_resolution_check.value: ("career_event_instances"."status" = 'resolved') = ("career_event_instances"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "career_event_instances"."selected_choice_id" IS NOT NULL)

contracts_signed_at_check.name: contracts_signed_at_check
contracts_signed_at_check.value: "contracts"."status" NOT IN ('accepted', 'active', 'completed') OR "contracts"."signed_at" IS NOT NULL

contracts_period_check.name: contracts_period_check
contracts_period_check.value: "contracts"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "contracts"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "contracts"."ends_at" >= "contracts"."starts_at"

sponsorships_accepted_at_check.name: sponsorships_accepted_at_check
sponsorships_accepted_at_check.value: "sponsorships"."status" NOT IN ('active', 'completed') OR "sponsorships"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL

sponsorships_period_check.name: sponsorships_period_check
sponsorships_period_check.value: "sponsorships"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "sponsorships"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "sponsorships"."ends_at" >= "sponsorships"."starts_at"

wallet_transactions_sign_check.name: wallet_transactions_sign_check
wallet_transactions_sign_check.value: ("wallet_transactions"."transaction_type" NOT IN ('training_cost', 'item_purchase', 'item_upgrade') OR "wallet_transactions"."amount" < 0) AND ("wallet_transactions"."transaction_type" NOT IN ('starter_grant', 'match_reward', 'achievement_reward', 'item_sale', 'contract_payment', 'sponsor_payout') OR "wallet_transactions"."amount" > 0)

match_balls_extra_type_check.name: match_balls_extra_type_check
match_balls_extra_type_check.value: ("match_balls"."extra_type" IS NULL) = ("match_balls"."extras" = 0) AND ("match_balls"."extra_type" IS NULL OR "match_balls"."extra_type" IN ('wide', 'no_ball', 'bye', 'leg_bye'))

match_balls_wicket_check.name: match_balls_wicket_check
match_balls_wicket_check.value: "match_balls"."wicket" = ("match_balls"."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL) AND "match_balls"."wicket" = ("match_balls"."dismissed_participant_id" IS NOT NULL)

matches_started_at_check.name: matches_started_at_check
matches_started_at_check.value: "matches"."status" NOT IN ('in_progress', 'completed') OR "matches"."started_at" IS NOT NULL

matches_completion_check.name: matches_completion_check
matches_completion_check.value: ("matches"."status" = 'completed') = ("matches"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "matches"."result_type" IS NOT NULL AND "matches"."result_type" <> 'abandoned')
